## readme

Open documentation for the CLI.

```bash
scalar readme [options] [command]
```

## readme generate

Self generate documentation for the cli.

```bash
scalar readme generate [options]
```

**Options**

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-o, --output [file]` | Path where the documentation file will be written. |

## upgrade

Upgrade current version of your cli.

```bash
scalar upgrade [options]
```

## context

Print every command, argument, and option as JSON for AI agents.

```bash
scalar context [options]
```

## completion

Generate shell completion definitions.

```bash
scalar completion [options] <shell>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `shell` | **Required.** Shell to configure. One of `bash`, `zsh`, `fish`. |
